title: DropBack: refund the price drop, keep the sale
instructions: Voice: a confident, warm product-launch narrator. Pace: brisk but clear, like a polished startup demo video. Short natural pauses at full stops. Slight emphasis on the dollar amounts and on the product name DropBack.

scenes.say: [confident] This is DropBack, powered by PayPal and Channel3. … When the price drops, your customer KEEPS the item… and you keep the sale.
scenes.vo: This is DropBack, powered by PayPal and Channel3. When the price drops, your customer keeps the item and you keep the sale.

scenes.say: [serious] Last year, American shoppers sent back $890 billion of merchandise. … Almost seventeen percent of everything they bought.
scenes.caption: Shoppers sent back *$890 billion* of merchandise. / Almost *17%* of everything they bought.

visual.label: *$890 billion* in US retail returns, 2024
visual.source: NRF & Happy Returns, 2024 Consumer Returns report

scenes.vo: Last year, American shoppers sent back $890 billion of merchandise. Almost seventeen percent of everything they bought.

scenes.say: And some returns have NOTHING to do with the product. A shopper pays $398. Days later, it's $298 somewhere else. … So they send it back, and buy it again… cheaper.
scenes.caption: Some returns have *nothing to do with the product.* / Pays *$398.* Days later it's *$298* elsewhere. / So they send it back… and *buy it again, cheaper.*
scenes.vo: And some returns have nothing to do with the product. A shopper pays $398. Days later, it's $298 somewhere else. So they send it back, and buy it again cheaper.

scenes.say: [thoughtful] For the merchant, that return costs FAR more than the difference. Return shipping, restocking, an open-box markdown, and the profit on a sale that's gone… about $291… to avoid a $100 gap.
scenes.caption: That return costs *far more than the difference.* / Shipping, restocking, open-box, the lost sale: *about $291* / to avoid a *$100* gap.
scenes.vo: For the merchant, that return costs far more than the difference. Return shipping, restocking, an open-box markdown, and the profit on a sale that's gone about $291 to avoid a $100 gap.

scenes.say: Some stores offer price matching. But checking rival prices by hand is slow… and most shoppers never even know the policy exists.
scenes.caption: Price matching exists. But checking rival prices *by hand is slow,* / and *most shoppers never know* the policy exists.

visual.meta: Checkbook.org · survey of retailer price-adjustment policies
visual.title: Most shoppers are unaware price adjustments exist, because few retailers advertise them.

scenes.vo: Some stores offer price matching. But checking rival prices by hand is slow and most shoppers never even know the policy exists.

scenes.say: [warmly] DropBack plugs into the checkout a merchant already has. Channel3 watches the exact product across retailers, with its price history. AI weighs a refund against a likely return. And the merchant sends a PayPal refund… in ONE click.
scenes.caption: DropBack plugs into the *checkout a merchant already has.* / *Channel3* watches the exact product across retailers, with *price history.* / *AI* weighs refund vs. return; the merchant *refunds in one click.*
scenes.vo: DropBack plugs into the checkout a merchant already has. Channel3 watches the exact product across retailers, with its price history. AI weighs a refund against a likely return. And the merchant sends a PayPal refund in one click.

scenes.say: [upbeat] Here it is, live in PayPal Sandbox. A merchant joins in a couple of minutes. They create a workspace for their store…
scenes.caption: Live in *PayPal Sandbox.* A merchant joins in *a couple of minutes:* / they create a workspace for their store.
scenes.vo: Here it is, live in PayPal Sandbox. A merchant joins in a couple of minutes. They create a workspace for their store

scenes.say: …and connect their own PayPal account. DropBack checks the keys with PayPal and encrypts the secret. From then on, paid orders from their checkout flow in by webhook.
scenes.caption: They connect *their own PayPal account.* Keys verified, secret *encrypted.* / Paid orders from their checkout *flow in by webhook.*
scenes.vo: and connect their own PayPal account. DropBack checks the keys with PayPal and encrypts the secret. From then on, paid orders from their checkout flow in by webhook.

scenes.say: They pick the retailers they'll price-match… Channel3 links their products for live monitoring… and they turn protection on.
scenes.caption: They pick the *retailers they'll match.* / *Channel3* links their products for monitoring, / and they *turn protection on.*
scenes.vo: They pick the retailers they'll price-match Channel3 links their products for live monitoring and they turn protection on.

scenes.say: Now a shopper picks Sony headphones in the Holloway store… $398, covered for 14 days.
scenes.caption: A shopper picks *Sony headphones*: / *$398*, covered for *14 days.*
scenes.vo: Now a shopper picks Sony headphones in the Holloway store $398, covered for 14 days.

scenes.say: They check out with PayPal. DropBack creates the order through PayPal's Server SDK.
scenes.caption: They check out *with PayPal.* / The order is created through *PayPal's Server SDK.*
scenes.vo: They check out with PayPal. DropBack creates the order through PayPal's Server SDK.

scenes.say: The buyer signs in to PayPal, and approves. The payment is captured.
scenes.caption: The buyer signs in to PayPal *and approves.* / The payment is *captured.*
scenes.vo: The buyer signs in to PayPal, and approves. The payment is captured.

scenes.say: Day three. The buyer opens their order… and checks the live market price.
scenes.caption: *Day three.* The buyer opens their order / and checks the *live market price.*
scenes.vo: Day three. The buyer opens their order and checks the live market price.

scenes.say: Channel3 checks new, in-stock offers for the EXACT same model, only from retailers this store price-matches. The lowest: $298 at Beach Camera. That's $100 less.
scenes.caption: *Channel3* checks new, in-stock offers for the exact model, / only from retailers this store matches. Lowest: *$298* at *Beach Camera.* That's *$100 less.*
scenes.vo: Channel3 checks new, in-stock offers for the exact same model, only from retailers this store price-matches. The lowest: $298 at Beach Camera. That's $100 less.

scenes.say: And it's verified by Channel3: the retailer, and 46 days of price history for this exact product. It held steady at $319.99… so the merchant can see today's $298 is a real drop, not a guess.
scenes.caption: *Verified by Channel3:* the retailer, and *46 days* of price history. It held steady at $319.99, / so today's *$298* is a *real drop,* not a guess.
scenes.vo: And it's verified by Channel3: the retailer, and 46 days of price history for this exact product. It held steady at $319.99 so the merchant can see today's $298 is a real drop, not a guess.

scenes.say: Instead of sending it back… they ask for the difference.
scenes.caption: Instead of sending it back, / they *ask for the difference.*
scenes.vo: Instead of sending it back they ask for the difference.

scenes.say: On the merchant side, every request lands in AG Grid: the buyer, the live offer, and the refund… versus the cost of a return.
scenes.caption: Every request lands in *AG Grid:* / the buyer, the live offer, and the *refund vs. the cost of a return.*
scenes.vo: On the merchant side, every request lands in AG Grid: the buyer, the live offer, and the refund versus the cost of a return.

scenes.say: The merchant's case report opens on the same Channel3 evidence. The AI puts the return risk at 57 percent. Counting the lost sale, a return would cost about $291… so refunding $100 saves about $65 on average. [firm] Policy limits are NEVER left to the model.
scenes.caption: The case report opens on the *Channel3 evidence.* Return risk: *57%.* / A return, counting the lost sale: *about $291.* Refunding $100 saves *about $65.* / *Limits are never left to the model.*
scenes.vo: The merchant's case report opens on the same Channel3 evidence. The AI puts the return risk at 57 percent. Counting the lost sale, a return would cost about $291 so refunding $100 saves about $65 on average. Policy limits are never left to the model.

scenes.say: The merchant approves. PayPal refunds $100 to the original payment… with an idempotency key, so it can NEVER pay twice.
scenes.caption: The merchant approves. PayPal refunds *$100* to the original payment, / with an *idempotency key,* so it can *never pay twice.*
scenes.vo: The merchant approves. PayPal refunds $100 to the original payment with an idempotency key, so it can never pay twice.

scenes.say: [warmly] The buyer sees it right away. Refund credited. They keep their headphones… and the merchant keeps the sale.
scenes.caption: Refund *credited.* They keep their headphones, / and the merchant *keeps the sale.*
scenes.vo: The buyer sees it right away. Refund credited. They keep their headphones and the merchant keeps the sale.

scenes.say: The overview tracks every refund… and the returns it avoided.
scenes.caption: The overview tracks *every refund,* / and the *returns it avoided.*
scenes.vo: The overview tracks every refund and the returns it avoided.

scenes.say: Every PayPal call runs through the APIMatic-generated PayPal Server SDK, and every price comes from Channel3. AI agents can read the claims… through DropBack's own MCP server.
scenes.caption: Every PayPal call: the *APIMatic-generated PayPal Server SDK.* Every price: *Channel3.* / AI agents read claims through DropBack's *MCP server.*
scenes.vo: Every PayPal call runs through the APIMatic-generated PayPal Server SDK, and every price comes from Channel3. AI agents can read the claims through DropBack's own MCP server.

scenes.say: [confident] Fewer returns. Proof for every refund, from Channel3. And the money… stays on PayPal.

items.title: Fewer *returns*
items.sub: refund the gap, not the box

scenes.vo: Fewer returns. Proof for every refund, from Channel3. And the money stays on PayPal.

scenes.say: DropBack, by Sartech Labs. Built on PayPal… powered by Channel3.
scenes.vo: DropBack, by Sartech Labs. Built on PayPal powered by Channel3.
